thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: P1 — prompt-routing error rate jumped to 28% across eu-west-1 -> customer-facing latency and some 5xxs. Paging oncall. @sre-jordan

sre-jordan: saw it, joining now. any recent deploys or flag flips?

alex: pushed a canary for experimental prompt-mux ~8m ago. small percentage traffic. metrics trended at t+4m.

maria: checking routing logs. seeing NACKs from prompt-mux v2 on the new endpoint, connection resets. also a spike in queue length on the worker pool.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary-deploy 2026-03-17T10:02Z -> status: partially healthy (2/3 pods ready), rolling back disabled.

eng-sam: if it's connection resets we should flip the feature flag to route to stable immediately. can someone hit the flag API?

alex: i'm on it — trying quick kill via control-plane. curl -X POST "https://flags.internal.redwood/api/v1/flags/prompt_mux_v2/kill" -d '{"override":"oncall"}' 

maria: heads-up: the flag API threw 502 first try, retrying via admin console UI.

alex: ok console accepted it. initiating killflip -> routing now forced to prompt-mux-v1 stable. traffic rebalanced.

sre-jordan: monitoring… error rate falling. 503s dropping from 18% -> 6% in 60s. latency back to baseline in some routes. good sign.

eng-sam: awesome. please keep the kill in place and collect traces for the canary pods; we need root cause.

maria: collecting pcap and app logs from the failed pods. saving to /var/tmp/incident-4301122334-logs.tar.gz.

ops-bot: alert: some customers hit visible failures for ~5-7 minutes. recommend status-page incident and CS ping.

cs-rebecca: drafting message for impacted customers. quick note: "We've temporarily routed traffic away from an experimental endpoint; you may have experienced short delays or failed prompts between 10:02-10:09 UTC. We're investigating and will follow up with details." anyone want to add?

alex: add that we're prioritizing request replay and logs; we'll share ETA for root cause in 2 hours.

sre-jordan: oncall handoff: @maria will take primary for postmortem and RCA. i'll stay until stable then hand to monday oncall.

maria: acknowledged. plan: 1) keep flag off until RCA, 2) gather kernel traces + JVM stacks from canary pods, 3) replicate in staging with identical canary config, 4) postmortem doc in /docs/incidents/4301122334.

eng-sam: also add a play to fallback to smaller batch sizes if we see queue pressure; looks like batching interactions with the new kernel caused the resets.

cs-rebecca: posted status page and emailed known customers. will send CSAT/ops follow-up once RCA draft is ready.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: 4301122334. Severity: P1 -> mitigated (traffic reroute). Tickets: #INC-2301 created for RCA.

sre-jordan: closing loop: keep monitoring for 30 more minutes, then we can de-escalate from P1 if stable. great job everyone. :thumbsup:
